narrative:
Wood County has 88,564 registered voters, with 17.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 25.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 26.7% of registrants.
